newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea yields end lower on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea yields end lower on institutional buying.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds fell for the third straight day this week on active institutional buying triggered by improved short-term liquidity, traders said on Wednesday.
Three month CD yields also dropped amid lack of new issues and increasing demand.
* Overnight average call rates at 14.5 vs 14.8
Three month CD yields also dropped amid lack of new issues and rising demand, traders said.
Falling overnight call rates and commercial paper yields also fuelled the decline.
